verdict.rationale: Nothing in the pack documents white-labeling or embedding the platform itself. The closest adjacent evidence is customer-facing use: self-hosting via Docker/Helm, a full-code app builder for custom React/Svelte frontends backed by Windmill runnables, and 'app guests' who sign in through your own identity provider without holding a Windmill account. missing for 10: explicit white-label/rebranding support, embedding mechanism (iframe/SDK/embedded editor) for end customers, multi-tenant customer provisioning docs, independent corroboration.
